title: White Rice with Peas, No Added Fat

content.title: About
content.content: White rice with peas, no added fat is a ready‑to‑eat product consisting of boiled white rice and green peas. It contains no added oils, sugars, or salt, making it a convenient option for a quick, balanced meal.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The rice‑pea combination provides a complete set of essential amino acids.
White rice is quickly digestible, while peas add plant protein and fiber.
The product is often used in infant nutrition and recovery diets.
Lack of added fat makes it a low‑calorie choice for weight management.
Peas are a good source of vitamin B1 (thiamine), supporting energy metabolism.

items.title: Carbohydrate source
items.content: White rice supplies fast‑acting carbohydrates for immediate energy.

items.title: Plant protein
items.content: Peas contribute about 5 g of protein per 100 g, helping maintain muscle mass.

items.title: Fiber
items.content: Peas provide both soluble and insoluble fiber, promoting healthy digestion and satiety.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: The dish contains thiamine, niacin, and folate, essential for carbohydrate metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Minerals
items.content: Peas supply iron, magnesium, and phosphorus, important for blood health and bones.

items.title: Legume allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to peas.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: White rice has a high GI, so people with diabetes should monitor portion sizes.

items.title: Phytic acid content
items.content: Peas contain phytic acid, which can reduce mineral absorption when consumed in excess.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The product is ready to eat after heating in the microwave or on the stove. It can be added to soups, salads, served as a side dish with meat or fish, or enjoyed on its own.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the package in a dry, cool place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, consume within 3‑5 days and keep refrigerated.
